inputs.text: Vertical close video-call shot two weeks later. Chen Mo's same handsome persona is lit by colder laptop light with a warm lamp behind, creating an attractive but subtly pressuring contrast. He claims to risk all his savings and invokes a shared future. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll film, 65mm lens, restrained psychological tension, no text, no logo. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: Chen Mo sits upright, hands composed and expression serious. Action: he leans closer, speaks with increasing urgency, presses one palm lightly to his chest, then extends that hand toward camera. End: he waits with fixed persuasive eye contact. Motion is medium and deliberate. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. He speaks steadily with subtle lip movement; the warmth becomes more urgent near the end.
